Type: French country dining armchair, set of two
Use: dining, occasional seating; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: carved wood frame in natural finish, woven cane back, linen-look upholstered seat, padded armrests
Colors: light warm natural wood, beige
Shape: square cane-panel back, curved open arms with padded rests, upholstered seat, turned fluted front legs, medium size
Feel: warm, elegant, rustic
Goes with: natural or distressed wood tables, white walls, linen textiles; French country or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam French Country Dining Chair with Arms, Set of 2, 24.6"W, Beige and Natural
product.description: Add rustic, old-world charm to your dining room with this set of 2 French country-inspired dining chairs. An ideal complement for vintage and farmhouse-style home decor, these chairs features a solid wood frame, rattan backing and comfortable upholstered seat and armrests. Overall: 24.63"W x 23.25"D x 37"H; seat height: 17.75"H; seat depth: 19"D; seat back height: 20.25"H; arm height: 25.5"H Sturdy wood frame and legs in a distressed natural finish with rattan backing and durable upholstered seat This set of 2 vintage-inspired dining chairs double as accent chairs for the living room or anywhere you need extra seating. Foam padding and elastic suspension system keep the back and seat firm and springy. Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
